words.explanation: n. [C] the typical weather conditions in a particular area 气候
words.example: Sea animals are greatly aﬀected by climate change.

words.explanation: a. 1 an ambitious plan, idea, etc. shows a desire to do sth. good but difficult, involving a lot of work（计划、主意等）显示雄心的；需要极大努力（才干）才能完成的
words.example: Our country has made an ambitious plan for managing health care.

words.explanation: n. [C, usu. pl.] a gas or other substance that is sent out into the air 排气；排放物
words.example: We are doing all we can to reduce the emission of CO 2 .

words.explanation: a. the best or most important 最好的；最重要的
words.example: He is one of the country's foremost scientists in physics.

words.explanation: n. [U] a feeling of being comfortable, healthy, and happy 舒适；健康；幸福
words.example: We hope to improve the health and well-being of poor children in rural areas.

words.explanation: a. an action or process that is sustainable can continue or last for a long time 能长期保持的；能长期维持的；能持续的
words.example: We need to protect our environment to achieve sustainable economic growth.

words.explanation: a. (only before noun) relating to how plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment 生态的
words.example: The worldwide ecological changes have aroused wide public concern.

words.explanation: n. [U] the state of human society that is very developed and organized 文明
words.example: People say that civilization is always on the move.

words.explanation: n. [U] 碳
n. [U] eagerness and willingness to do sth. 动力；积极性；兴趣
words.example: You can do anything once you've got the motivation.

words.explanation: a. concerning or affecting the air, land, or water on Earth 自然环境的；影响自然环境的
words.example: Oil leaking in the sea will cause a high level of environmental damage.

words.explanation: n. [U] 二氧化碳
n. [U] a complete change in sb. or sth.（彻底的）改变，改观
words.example: After three weeks we noticed a total transformation in her behavior.

words.explanation: n. [U] the careful use of energy, water, and other resources, so that they are not wasted or lost（能源、水等资源的）节约使用
words.example: The government has taken energy conservation measures to protect environment.

words.explanation: n. [C] all the animals and plants in a particular area, and the way in which they are related to each other and to their environment 生态系统
n. [U] the act of returning sth. to its correct place, condition or owner 复原；复位；回归；归还
words.example: The first task following the earthquake was the restoration of clean water supplies.

words.explanation: n. 1 [U] the process of producing sth. or making sth. happen 产生；发生
words.example: We are making plans about the generation of electricity.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that can be burned to produce heat or energy 燃料
n. [U] the production of electricity by the force of fast moving water 水力发电
a. ( only before noun ) using the power of the sun's light and heat 利用太阳光的；太阳能的
words.example: We know that solar energy is widely used in many places.

words.explanation: vt. 1 to make land that has never been used, or that is not good enough to be used, able to be used for farming, housing, etc. 开垦；开拓
words.example: The government is trying to reclaim desert land for farming.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] a large area of land where it is always very hot and dry and there is a lot of sand 沙漠
n. [U] a process in which a material or object takes in liquid, gas, or heat 吸收
words.example: Sunlight is helpful for our body's absorption of iron.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] ( the ~ ) the mixture of gases that surrounds the Earth 大气（层）
n. [C, U] the ability to do sth. 能力；才能；技能
words.example: The firm plans to use new tools to increase its production capability.

words.explanation: n. [C] 风力发电涡轮机
n. [C] 太阳能电池板
a. relating to a particular region 地区的；区域的
words.example: Ella works in a regional newspaper office in Ohio.

words.explanation: vt. to help sth. to develop and be successful 促进；增进
words.example: The light promotes the rapid growth of plants.

words.explanation: n. [C] 省
a. ( be ~ to ) likely to do sth. or suffer from sth., esp. sth. bad or harmful 易于发生某事（尤指不好或有害的事）的；很可能…的
words.example: The coastal region is prone to earthquakes.

words.explanation: vt. ( fml. ) to try to stop sth. bad from happening or getting worse 与…斗争；抗争
words.example: A meeting will be held on how to combat pollution of the oceans.

words.explanation: n. [U] the situation or experience of being poor 贫穷；贫困
words.example: Many children around the world are being raised in poverty.

words.explanation: n. [C, usu. pl.] natural energy sources such as wind, water, and sunlight which are always available 可再生资源
n. [sing., U] agreement that sth. is true or important 承认；认可
words.example: The award is given to him in recognition of his contribution to the factory.

words.explanation: as the main reason or purpose of sth. 首要的是
words.example: First and foremost, parents should do their best to ensure that their kids have a sense of security.

words.explanation: used when you are telling sb. sth. that they probably already know or expect 不用说；当然
words.example: Needless to say, no theory can go unchallenged for long.

words.explanation: partly, or to a particular level 在某种程度上
words.example: Cats are trainable to a certain degree.

words.explanation: used to say that sth. is understood by everyone and that it does not need to be said 不用说；不言而喻
words.example: It goes without saying that our consumers would be happier if prices were lower.

words.explanation: used for talking about the general situation 总的说来
words.example: It was a pretty good show on the whole.

words.explanation: 《巴黎协定》
